difficulty_reason: The lemma is the projection formula for a proper morphism with coefficients in a torsion ring (statement lines 20192-20202). The proof (proof lines 20204-20215) checks the canonical map on stalks, reduces to an algebraically closed field base by proper base change for modulo n coefficients, and applies the constant-factor computation, the finite cohomological dimension being supplied by the proper dimension bound. H2: one reduction plus one application.
